title: User List
content: Create user list component for followers, following, search results. List layout: vertical list of user items. Item structure: avatar (w-12 h-12), name and username, short bio (truncated), follow button. Search: filter input at top. Sorting: alphabetical, most recent. Tabs: Followers, Following, Suggested. Empty states: "No followers yet". Mutual indicator: "Follows you" badge. Load more: pagination or infinite scroll.

variants.simple: Create list of users with avatars, names, and follow buttons.
variants.detailed: Create user list component for followers, following, search results. List layout: vertical list of user items. Item structure: avatar (w-12 h-12), name and username, short bio (truncated), follow button. Search: filter input at top. Sorting: alphabetical, most recent. Tabs: Followers, Following, Suggested. Empty states: "No followers yet". Mutual indicator: "Follows you" badge. Load more: pagination or infinite scroll.
variants.advanced: Create user list component for followers, following, search results, and suggestions. List layout: vertical list (divide-y divide-gray-100) or grid variant for discover pages. Item structure: flex items-center gap-3 py-3 hover:bg-gray-50 transition. Avatar: w-12 h-12 rounded-full, online indicator dot (w-3 h-3 bg-green-500 rounded-full absolute bottom-0 right-0 border-2 border-white). Info column (flex-1): name row (font-medium + verified badge if applicable), username (text-sm text-gray-500 @handle), short bio (text-sm text-gray-600 line-clamp-1). Follow button: right-aligned, appropriate state. Search: sticky filter input at top with Search icon, filters list as user types (debounced). Sorting dropdown: Alphabetical A-Z, Most Recent, Most Followers, Relevance (for search results). Tabs: for different lists (Followers, Following, Mutual, Suggested), tab bar with counts. Empty states: contextual messages - "No followers yet" with suggestion to share profile, "Not following anyone" with discover suggestion, "No results for [query]". Mutual indicator: "Follows you" text badge (text-xs text-gray-500) next to username. Verified badge: blue checkmark for verified users. Load more: pagination with "Show more" button or infinite scroll with IntersectionObserver. Hover preview: show profile card popup on hover (desktop) with 200ms delay. Bulk actions: for admin views, checkboxes with select all, bulk remove. Quick view: chevron or expand button to show more user details inline without navigating. Recent activity: "Active 2h ago" or "Last seen yesterday" timestamp in text-xs text-gray-400. Grid variant: profile cards in responsive grid (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3) for browse/discover pages. Loading: skeleton list items with avatar circle and text lines. Accessibility: list role, items as listitem, follow buttons properly labeled.
